title: Jellylike Earthy Malaysian Gelatin Pudding
description: A traditional Malaysian dessert featuring unflavored gelatin and earthy flavors, perfect for a date night, this ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly pudding is both chewy and delicious, with a unique texture that will leave you wanting more.

ingredients.name: unflavored gelatin
ingredients.notes: use high quality gelatin for best results

instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over 1/4 cup of water and let it sit for 5 minutes to soften.
In a medium saucepan, combine the palm sugar, coconut milk, and 1 3/4 cups of water, and heat over medium heat, stirring until the sugar is dissolved.
Add the softened gelatin to the saucepan and stir until it is fully dissolved.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the pandan extract and grated ginger.
Let the mixture cool to room temperature, then cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours, or until set.
Just before serving, sprinkle the sesame seeds over the top of the pudding.
Cut the pudding into small cubes and serve chilled.
Garnish with additional sesame seeds and grated ginger, if desired.
